messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Et moi à lui Poète je te supplie par ce Dieu que tu ne connut pas, afin que je fuie ce mal et pire,

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | E | discourse connector “and” | Et | “and” | OK | | io (1) | speaker, subject of the speech act | moi | “me/I” | OK | | a | preposition marking addressee | à | “to” | OK | | lui | male addressee, indirect object | lui | “him” | OK | | Poeta | vocative title “Poet” | Poète | “Poet” | OK | | io (2) | speaker, subject of the request | je | “I” | OK | | ti | second‑person singular object of “beseech” | te | “you” | OK | | richeggio | present‑tense “beseech” (1st sg) | supplie | “beseech” | OK | | per | preposition introducing instrumental basis | par | “by” | OK | | quello | demonstrative “that” (specifying the God) | ce | “that” | OK | | Dio | the deity invoked | Dieu | “God” | OK | | che | relative pronoun introducing clause | que | “that/whom” | OK | | tu | second‑person singular subject of relative clause | tu | “you” | OK | | non | negation particle | ne | “not” | OK | | conos​cesti | past‑tense “you did not know” (2nd sg) | connut | “did not know” | **GRAMMAR** (verb form should be *connus* for 2nd sg) | | acciò | purpose conjunction “in order that” | afin | “so … that” | OK | | ch'io | contracted purpose subordinator “that I” | que je | “that I” | OK | | fuga | subjunctive “may escape” (1st sg) | fuie | “may escape” | OK | | questo | demonstrative “this” (specifying the ill) | ce | “this” | OK | | male | noun “ill, bad condition” | mal | “ill” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | et | “and” | OK | | peggio | comparative adjective “worse” (more severe) | pire | “worse” | OK |
---
### Items to Note
- **GRAMMAR:** *conoscesti* → **connut** – French verb form should agree with 2nd person singular (*connus*), not 3rd person singular (*connut*). - **UNNECESSARY (extra target elements):** - **pas** – added to complete French negation (*ne … pas*); not present in the source. - Punctuation marks omitted from the source (colon “:”, opening quotation mark “«”) are naturally absent in French rendering.
No source words are missing or incorrectly translated beyond the noted agreement error.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only French script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 130: - Original: Et moi à lui Poète je te supplie - Issue: none - Corrected: Et moi à lui Poète je te supplie
- Line 131: - Original: par ce Dieu que tu ne connais pas, - Issue: GRAMMAR – verb form should be 2nd sg passé simple “connus” - Corrected: par ce Dieu que tu ne connus pas,
- Line 132: - Original: afin que je fuie ce mal et pire, - Issue: none - Corrected: afin que je fuie ce mal et pire,
